# StockQB

> StockQB is beginner investing education: reading stock quotes, P/E ratios, ETFs vs mutual funds, dividends, order types, and building a first portfolio.

StockQB.com is an independent investing-education site. It does not recommend specific securities, and all examples use hypothetical tickers and numbers. Not investment advice.

## Pages

- [Home](https://stockqb.com/): StockQB is your stock market quarterback: learn to read stock quotes, P/E ratios, ETFs vs mutual funds, dividends, order types, and build a beginner portfolio.
- [How to read a stock quote: every field explained](https://stockqb.com/how-to-read-a-stock-quote.html): Ticker, bid/ask, volume, market cap, 52-week range, and the other numbers on a quote page.
- [P/E ratio explained: what it tells you about a stock's valuation](https://stockqb.com/pe-ratio-explained.html): Trailing vs forward P/E, PEG, earnings yield, CAPE, and the pitfalls of valuation shortcuts.
- [ETFs vs mutual funds: the key differences explained](https://stockqb.com/etfs-vs-mutual-funds.html): How ETFs and mutual funds trade, what they cost, how they are taxed, and which fits you.
- [Dividend investing basics: yield, key dates, and taxes](https://stockqb.com/dividend-investing-basics.html): How dividends are paid, the ex-dividend date, yield and payout ratio, taxes, DRIPs, and yield traps.
- [Stock order types: market, limit, stop, and stop-limit orders](https://stockqb.com/stock-order-types.html): Market, limit, stop, stop-limit, and trailing stop orders, plus day vs GTC, with examples.
- [How to build a beginner stock portfolio: a step-by-step playbook](https://stockqb.com/beginner-portfolio-playbook.html): Choose an account, set an asset allocation, pick low-cost funds, automate, and rebalance.

## About

- [About StockQB](https://stockqb.com/about.html): StockQB is an independent investing education site that explains stock market basics in plain language with hypothetical examples. No stock picks and no hype.
- [Contact](https://stockqb.com/contact.html): How to reach StockQB by email (hello@stockqb.com).
- [Privacy policy](https://stockqb.com/privacy.html): What little data the site collects and how it is used.
